title: The Beggar Saint
text: A beggar sits on the pilgrim road in rags, sores on his hands, a light about him that may only be the sun. The faithful who pass leave him their best and swear he is a saint in disguise. The ones who pass him by never seem to reach the shrine.

options.label: Give him your best, as the faithful do, in case the stories are true.

outcomes.text: He blesses you with a sore-covered hand, and the light about him brightens for a moment. Your path feels lucky after.

options.label: The shrewdest tests whether he is truly a saint, and risks finding out.

outcomes.text: He is. He looks at them, once, and they will never quite meet anyone's eyes again.
He is not, but he is very clever, and he gives them a cut of the takings to go away quietly.

options.label: Pass him by. Saints do not sit in the dirt.

outcomes.text: A cold feeling settles on you, and stays all day, as if the road itself has turned its back.
